identityTradability.exchangeName: UiPath, Inc. Class A Common Stock

discovery-weak-signals.name: agentic orchestration demand
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Double-digit ARR growth accompanies a product strategy centered on governed orchestration of agents and automation.

discovery-weak-signals.name: enterprise governance differentiation
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Deterministic automation plus orchestration targets a practical control gap as enterprises deploy autonomous agents.

expectations-execution.name: operating discipline
expectations-execution.basis: Positive GAAP operating income alongside growth provides stronger execution evidence than growth without operating profitability.

expectations-execution.name: near-term expectation checkpoint
expectations-execution.basis: Investor Day may clarify adoption and targets, but future disclosures must not be inferred before publication.

thesisQuality.basis: Double-digit ARR growth and profitable operating evidence support real automation demand; agentic-specific adoption remains unquantified.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: ARR growth and positive GAAP operating income accompany roughly 15% TTM revenue growth.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 25 valuation near 3.77x sales and 18.42x trailing earnings provides plausible headroom without exceptional outcomes.

catalystScore.basis: Agentic orchestration commercialization and continued ARR/profitability conversion are identifiable catalysts, with product-specific adoption unquantified.

governancePower.basis: Improved operating discipline is offset by leadership-transition risk and limited long-duration capital-allocation evidence.

alignment2036.basis: Governed orchestration of AI agents, robots and enterprise workflows addresses a durable automation/control need.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: A common platform spans RPA, APIs, agents, process orchestration and intelligence across workflows.

bottleneckControl.basis: Governance and deterministic automation create workflow friction, but hyperscalers and application vendors can bundle alternatives.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Automation remains useful across AI adoption paths, though value capture depends on UiPath retaining orchestration relevance.

substitutionResilience.basis: Installed workflows create switching friction, but credible bundled substitutes prevent a strong-band assessment.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Software delivery limits physical supply dependence; evidence does not justify exceptional infrastructure redundancy claims.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring enterprise software economics support some pricing flexibility, constrained by competitive bundling and uncertain mix.

riskEvidence.basis: Bundled substitution, leadership transition and uncertain agentic contribution remain material risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary Q2 evidence and independent current market data cover core factors; agentic ARR and concentration remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: Recurring automation demand and improving operating discipline support UiPath's governed-agentic opportunity, tempered by substitution risk.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Hyperscalers and application suites can bundle orchestration while agentic-product ARR remains unisolated.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Sustained ARR growth, profitable conversion and quantified agentic-orchestration adoption.
